source_notes.note: Source formatting is partially corrupted in several places. Mechanics below preserve explicit content and separate uncertain or merged fields into notes rather than inventing missing values.
Entries in this file include both headed sections and embedded monster entries without their own headings.

interaction.notes: Bats do not rely on normal sight.

ability.name: echolocation
ability.effect: Navigation does not depend on normal sight.

ability.name: swarm_form_reference
ability.trigger: When a bat swarm is rolled
ability.effect: Use swarm rules from the swarm subsystem.

modifier.condition: ordinary bats not under another creature's control

interaction.notes: Bats do not rely on normal sight.

ability.name: echolocation
ability.effect: Navigation does not depend on normal sight.

ability.name: paralyzing_bite
ability.effect: Target must save vs Paralysis or be paralyzed.

ability.name: blood_drain
ability.trigger: Victim is paralyzed and bat is not distracted
ability.effect: Bat feeds, dealing 1d4 damage per round.

ability.name: vampire_creation
ability.trigger: Victim is killed by blood loss from a giant vampiric bat
ability.effect: Victim must save vs Spells or rise as a vampire.

shared_rules.rule: All bears attack with 2 claws and 1 bite.
If both claws hit in one round, the bear also hugs for an additional 2d8 damage.

ecology_and_behavior.behavior_rules: Usually avoids combat unless forced or defending cubs.

ability.name: blood_scent_tracking
ability.effect: Can follow wounded creatures by the smell of their blood.

mobility_rules.rule: Adept at swimming and moving on ice and snow.

ability.name: poison_sting
ability.effect: Target must save vs Poison or die.

ability.name: broken_stinger
ability.trigger: Successful sting attack by a normal giant killer bee
ability.effect: Stinger breaks off in victim.
ability.follow_up: Surviving victim takes 1 damage per round until stinger is removed.

ability.name: stinger_death
ability.effect: Bee dies on the following round from the trauma of losing its stinger.

social_structure.rule: Each hive is ruled by a queen bee with 2 Hit Dice.
Queen is guarded by 10 large drones with 1 Hit Die each.
Queen may sting multiple times; her stinger does not break off on a successful attack.

resource.name: giant_killer_bee_honey
resource.effect: Acts as a half-strength potion of healing.

ability.name: light_organs
ability.effect: Produces light in a 10' radius.

ability.name: harvestable_light_organs
ability.effect: Continue to illuminate an area.

ability.name: toxic_spray
ability.effect: Target suffers painful chemical burns and blisters.
ability.follow_up: Target takes -2 penalty to attack throws.
ability.termination: Ends early if cure light wounds is used.

special_defense.name: fire_only_damage
special_defense.effect: Can be damaged only by fire; torches, magical flame, and a flame tongue sword deal full damage.

mobility_rules.rule: Can move on floors, walls, and ceilings.
Can compress through small fissures and under door cracks.

ability.name: digestion
ability.effect: Digests metal and wood, but not stone.

ability.name: cold_reaction
ability.effect: Takes no damage.
ability.follow_up: Becomes paralyzed for 1 round per die of damage the attack would normally deal.

ability.name: splitting
ability.trigger: Hit by normal or magical weapons, lightning, or electricity
ability.effect: Suffers no damage and splits into 2 puddings.

procedure.step: Judge divides the original pudding's Hit Dice between the two resulting puddings.
Neither resulting pudding may have fewer than 2 Hit Dice.

ability.name: minimum_split_size_rule
ability.effect: Deals only 1d8 damage.
ability.exception: Cannot be split further and is unharmed by additional weapon or lightning-based attacks.

procedure.step: Blinks in close to prey for attack.
Reappears 1d4x10 feet away from the opponent.

ability.name: occupied_space_restriction
ability.effect: Never blinks into a space occupied by another object.

ability.name: blink_retreat
ability.effect: Blinks away and does not reappear.

ecology_and_behavior.communication: Has its own language of barks, yaps, whines, and growls capable of transmitting complex information.

ecology_and_behavior.behavior_rules: Usually does not initiate combat, but may attack to defend young or when threatened.
Attacks with little or no provocation.

ability.name: stealthy_bulk
ability.effect: Characters encountering bugbears suffer -1 penalty to surprise rolls.

social_structure.rule: Gang leader: champion with AC5, 4+1 HD, 25 hp, +2 damage from strength.
Warband leader: sub-chieftain with AC6, 5+1 HD, 29 hp, +3 damage from strength.
Lair or village leader: chieftain with AC7, 7+2 HD, 37 hp, +4 damage from strength.
While chieftain lives, bugbears gain +1 to morale rolls.
Lairs and villages include females and young equal to 50% of male count each.
Female bugbears fight as hobgoblins.
Young bugbears fight as kobolds.
Village has 75% chance of shaman present; shaman is statistically equivalent to sub-chieftain and has Clerical abilities at level 1d6.
Village has 50% chance of witch doctor present; witch doctor is statistically equivalent to champion and has Mage abilities at level 1d4.

ability.name: swallow_whole
ability.trigger: Unmodified attack throw of 19 or 20 against creature up to man-size
ability.effect: Target is swallowed whole.

ability.name: internal_damage
ability.effect: Target suffers 1d8 damage each round.
ability.termination: Ends when the caecilian is killed or the swallowed creature dies.

ability.name: inside_attack_restrictions
ability.effect: Swallowed target may attack only with a dagger.
ability.follow_up: Swallowed target suffers -4 penalty to attack throws while attacking from inside.

ability.name: digestion_timer
ability.trigger: Swallowed creature dies and remains in belly
ability.effect: Corpse becomes irrecoverably digested.

treasure_and_rewards.treasure_rules: Because caecilians swallow creatures whole, any encounter may yield treasure whether wandering or in lair; any treasure found is inside the creature's belly.

mobility_rules.rule: Can travel for 2 weeks without water if well hydrated at the start.
Does not suffer movement penalties in desert terrain.

references.notation_reference: Source table is partially corrupted; wilderness encounter and alignment were merged in the source and normalized conservatively here.

shared_rules.rule: Large cats kill only for food or in defense.
Large cats always give chase if an opponent runs away.
A large cat that has tasted human blood may become a man-killer and prefer hunting humans.

ability.name: woodland_stealth
ability.effect: Characters encountering tigers in wooded environments suffer -2 penalty to surprise rolls.

ability.name: paralyzing_stingers
ability.effect: Target must save vs Paralysis or become paralyzed.

ability.name: swallow_paralyzed_target
ability.trigger: Not faced with additional opponents on subsequent round
ability.effect: Swallows paralyzed character, killing him.

ability.name: paralysis_cure_interaction
ability.effect: Paralysis may be cured with cure light wounds.
ability.exception: When used this way, cure light wounds does not heal damage.

social_structure.rule: Troop leader: chieftain with AC6, 5 HD, 29 hp, +2 damage from strength.
Chieftain has 50% chance of Clerical abilities at level 1d6.
Lair includes females and young equal to twice the number of males, plus an additional 5d6 young.
Female centaurs fight as 3 HD monsters and inflict 1d4/1d4 hoof damage.
Young centaurs fight as 2 HD monsters and inflict 1d2/1d2 hoof damage.

ecology_and_behavior.behavior_rules: Avoid conflict if possible, but males fight to guard their communities.
Usually females and young do not fight and try to escape if combat occurs.
If forced into combat, centaurs are unlikely to surrender.

ability.name: poison_bite
ability.effect: Bite itself inflicts no damage.
ability.on_failure: Victim is horribly sick for 10 days.

ability.name: poison_sickness_effect
ability.effect: While sick, victim moves at half speed and cannot perform other physical activity.

ability.name: dragon_head_breath
ability.trigger: Dragon head chooses breath instead of bite
ability.effect: Fiery cone 50' long and 10' wide at terminal end.

ability.name: dragon_head_attack_choice
ability.effect: Until breath uses are exhausted, dragon head uses either bite or breath weapon 50% of the time.
ability.termination: After breath is exhausted, dragon head may only bite.

ability.name: petrifying_attack
ability.effect: Target must save vs Petrification or turn to stone.

ability.name: touch_petrification
ability.trigger: Creature is touched with bare hands
ability.effect: Touching creature requires save vs Petrification or target turns to stone.
ability.exception: Weapon attacks, 10' pole prods, and similar maneuvers do not risk petrification.

treasure_and_rewards.treasure_rules: Any treasure in a nest is found on petrified victims and is accessible only if those victims are restored to flesh.

ecology_and_behavior.behavior_rules: Can exist in any watery environment and does not need to remain fully submerged.

shared_rules.rule: Characters encountering submerged crocodiles suffer -2 penalty to surprise rolls.

ability.name: poor_depth_perception
ability.effect: Suffers -2 penalty to attack throws.

ability.name: weekly_curse_variant
ability.effect: A few cyclops can issue a curse 1 time per week.

special_defense.name: weapon_immunity
special_defense.effect: Damaged only by magical or silver weapons.

ability.name: lycanthropy_transmission
ability.effect: Can pass on its form of lycanthropy.

ability.name: innate_charm
ability.effect: May charm others 3 times per day.

save.on_failure: utterly enslaved to demon boar's will

encounter_profile.behavior_rules: Usually tries to surprise and dominate opponents before direct combat.

social_structure.rule: When encountered in lair, 75% chance to have 1d3 charmed human thralls.
Thralls are rolled as NPC adventurers.
Thralls cannot cast spells or use magic items while mentally dominated.

special_defense.name: magic_only_affects
special_defense.effect: May only be affected by magic and magical weapons.

ability.name: spell_like_abilities
ability.limitation: Each listed ability usable 3 times per day.

procedure.step: Create food and water as a 7th level cleric.
Create temporary metal objects, softer metals lasting longer; gold lasts 24 hours, iron lasts 1 round; maximum weight 10 stone.
Create permanent goods of wood, rope, and similar softer materials; maximum weight 10 stone.
Create illusions as phantasmal force affecting both sight and sound; effect is permanent until touched or dispelled.

ability.name: whirlwind_form
ability.effect: Transforms into whirlwind.

special.rule: Creatures with 2 HD or less contacted by whirlwind must save vs Breath or be thrown 10' away.

ability.name: supernatural_strength
ability.effect: Can transport 60 stone easily.

ability.name: maximum_carry
ability.effect: Can transport up to 120 stone for 3 turns.

ability.name: tracking_equivalent
ability.effect: Most hunting dogs can scent prey and have the equivalent of Tracking proficiency.

ability.name: sight_hound_variant
ability.effect: Sight hounds move at 210'.

ability.name: battle_gear_profile
ability.trigger: Equipped with leather armor and spiked collar for battle
ability.effect: Movement becomes 90'.

ability.name: shape_assumption
ability.effect: Can take on the shape of any humanoid creature encountered.

ability.name: ambush_infiltration
ability.effect: Uses mimicry to stage ambushes, bait traps, and infiltrate humanoid society.
ability.follow_up: Often attempts to kill the person it imitates and then attack others by surprise.

ability.name: death_reversion
ability.effect: Reverts to natural form.
